user.title: OpenClaw Gateway
user.description: Connect Home Assistant Assist to the local OpenClaw Node add-on. The default URL points at the Supervisor add-on; for a standalone Docker node, point this at http://<node-host>:8099.

data.local_api_token: API token (optional, only if the node's local_api_token option is set)
data.actor_secret: Actor signing secret (optional, must match identity.actor_secret)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OpenClaw Gateway
reconfigure.description: Update the OpenClaw Node add-on URL, API token, and actor signing secret this integration points at.

data.local_api_token: API token (optional, only if the node's local_api_token option is set)
data.actor_secret: Actor signing secret (optional, must match identity.actor_secret)

abort.already_configured: This OpenClaw Gateway endpoint is already configured.
